title: BENTO BOXES / LUNCH SPECIALS
intro: DO SI KOREAN BBQ (logo with red 도시 calligraphy at top of page)

[Transcriber note] The page has two printed headings, BENTO BOXES and LUNCH SPECIALS; the combined title above is not printed as such. Lunch Specials are printed as a photo grid (6 across, then 5); items are listed row by row, left to right. Item names are printed in all caps. In the grid the chili icon sits under each photo rather than after the name.

[Transcriber note] Tags reflect printed markers only: 'best seller' = red BEST SELLER starburst badge; 'spicy' = chili-pepper icon. No vegetarian items on this page, though the legend includes the sprout icon. No other fine print is printed on this page.
